machine_start_gcode.default_value:
;Starting Custom Script
;
TransMode15 ;Config header
TransAccel2000 ;Config header
TransParam135 ;Config header
G90 ;Absolute coordinates
M83 ;Extruder Relative
G92 E0 ;Reset extruder
G28 X0 Y0 ;Home X and Y
M140 S{material_bed_temperature}; Set Bed Temperature
M141 S{build_volume_temperature}; Set IR1-Bed
M142 S{build_volume_temperature}; Set IR2-Wall
G1 Z25 F900 ;Movement in Z
G1 Z20 F300 ;Slow movement Z
M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0}; Wait for Bed Temp to stabilize
M109 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} T0; Wait until hozzle is at temp
G1 E-5.00  F300 ;Retract
M104 S{material_print_temperature} T0 ;Printing temperature
G1 X90 Y50 F6000 ;Move lateral to enter the bed
;
;End Custom Script

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;Ending Custom Script
;
M255 S0 ;Flash Fuse off
G91 ;Relative coordinates
M83 ;Extruder Relative
G1 Z5 F600 ;From last Z position move the bed down
G90 ;going back to absolute coordinates
G1 X1 Y1 F30000 ;Move off bed to purge
M106 S0 ;part blower fan
M104 S{material_print_temperature_layer_0} T0 ;Set low hozzle temp
G1 E75 F250 ;Purge
G1 E-5.00 F300 ;Retract
M104 S0 T0 ;Turn off hozzle
;
;End Custom Script
